report:
Breast, left, total mastectomy

The specimen consists of a left total mastectomy specimen (480 g, 180 x 150 x 40 mm) with an overlying skin ellipse (160 x 55 mm) bearing the nipple. Sectioning reveals an ill-defined, stellate, gritty, necrotic area measuring 55 mm in greatest dimension (55 x 40 x 30 mm) in the central breast and nipple, 15 mm from the posterior margin. The nipple is eczematous and crusted. Two lymph nodes are identified in the sentinel node specimen and entirely embedded.

(1-8) lesion with the nipple.
(9-12) posterior, superior, inferior and lateral margins.
(13) medial and anterior margins.
(14-15) background breast.
(16) sentinel lymph nodes (2 nodes).

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Total mastectomy
- Specimen laterality: Left
- Tumour site: Central, Nipple
- Number of blocks with DCIS out of total: 9 of 16 blocks

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Ductal carcinoma in situ (DCIS)
- Size (extent) of DCIS: Greatest dimension 55 mm (55 x 40 x 30 mm)
- Architectural patterns: Solid, Comedo
- Nuclear grade: Grade III (high)
- Tumour histology:
  Sections show ductal carcinoma in situ of high grade with solid and comedo
  architecture, with central (comedo) necrosis and associated
  microcalcification, spanning 55 mm (9 of 16 blocks). No invasive carcinoma is
  identified. Paget's disease of the nipple is present.
- Necrosis: Present, central (expansive "comedo" necrosis)
- Microcalcifications: Present in DCIS
- Nipple: Paget's disease present
- Additional lesions: Not identified

Ancillary studies
- Estrogen receptor: Negative, Internal control cells present and stain as
  expected
  - Intensity: Negative (0)
  - Positive nuclei(%): None (0)
- Progesterone receptor: Negative, Internal control cells present and stain as
  expected
  - Intensity: Negative (0)
  - Positive nuclei(%): None (0)
- Cold ischemia time: 30 min
  - Optimal (<= 60 min).
- Fixation time in buffered formalin: 48 hours
  - Optimal fixation (6-72 hours).
- Meet requirements specified in the latest version of the ASCO/CAP guidelines.
- Test type: Laboratory-developed test (QMH, HK).
- Formalin-fixed paraffin embedded sections were assessed by IHC technique for
  ER and PR, using Novocastra ER (clone: 6F11) and Dako PR (clone: PgR636) with
  the Bond polymer refined detection system.

- Posterior margin: Uninvolved by DCIS, closest distance: greater than 10 mm
- Superior margin: Uninvolved by DCIS, closest distance: greater than 10 mm

- Lateral margin: Uninvolved by DCIS, closest distance: greater than 10 mm
